pivot_logic_clarification.summary: The spreadsheet does NOT auto-switch pivot kits by good/maybe/bad. It shows multiple kit options (Red E HD, Red E Bearings, Needham, OEM) as manual quote checkboxes for the tech. Condition (maybe/bad) controls WHETHER and HOW MANY row-units get quoted — not which brand kit.
pivot_logic_clarification.app_implication: Do NOT map maybe→AG-K22 and bad→AG-K01. Use one default pivot SKU per machine series when replacement is needed. Pick the kit your team actually installs as default (likely AG-K36 greaseless or AG-K01 HD grease for 60/90).
